row: The Schwarzman Animal Medical Center is the world’s largest non-profit animal hospital with NYC’s only Level 1 Trauma Center. Our team of 130+ veterinarians work across more than 20 specialties to provide world-class medical care, and we are here for pets and their families 24/7. We are proud to have served the people and pets of New York, and beyond, for over 110 years. Learn more at www.amcny.org.
